Upper Text: [Main] You may place up to 3 Digimon cards with [Bagra Army] in their traits from your trash under 1 of your Digimon as its bottom digivolution cards or under 1 of your Tamers. Then, if you have a Digimon or Tamer with [Bagra Army] in its traits in play, place 1 of your opponent's Digimon under 1 of your opponent's other Digimon as its bottom digivolution card.
